_about: The Frostspire (levels 15-30): the frozen dwarven guards answer each other, ice trolls are elites, the frozen commander a sub-boss, the Frozen Dwarven King in his ancient vault raising his frozen guard as the vault goes dark, and Vyrkothas the Frost Wyrm on the summit breathing killing frost and calling ice elementals.

helpers.shout: A horn of ice sounds, and the frozen dead march to answer!
